title: Exact success and failure counts across a fixed number of workers
task: Write `Process(items []string, workers int, handle func(string) error) Summary` in package `batch` that hands the items to exactly `workers` goroutines, waits for all of them, and reports how many succeeded and how many failed. The counts must be exact under `go test -race`, and the test must not rely on timing. The counting code and the item handling code should not be tangled together.
